product_launches.description: Summation launched its Decision-Grade AI Platform, offering real-time, verified insights via a proprietary AI Calculation Engine for enterprise decision-making.

overview_description.description:
Summation delivers a decision-grade AI platform that helps enterprise teams to generate insights, automate workflows, and surface strategic opportunities. It consolidates data across systems such as ERP, CRM, EPM, and warehouses and enables leaders to trace analytical results back to source records for auditability and confidence. The platform includes modules for finance, operations, revenue, and executive overview.

Summation supports “Verified Tasks,” which automate report generation and analysis, and “Deep Dive,” which uses AI agents to explore large numbers of business questions in parallel. During deployment, the company offers a “Forward Deployed” model in which its engineers collaborate with clients to map workflows, model key metrics, and integrate systems.

about_short_description.short_description: Summation delivers an AI platform that helps enterprise teams to generate insights, automate workflows, and surface strategic opportunities.

product.name: Summation Decision-Grade AI Platform
product.description: An enterprise AI platform that connects financial and operational data, applies governed AI analysis, and delivers traceable insights for business planning and decision-making.

product.name: AI Calculation Engine
product.description: A computation engine for executing large volumes of business-data calculations and drill-down analysis to support real-time AI workloads.

product.name: Verified Tasks
product.description: A set of governed AI workflows for reporting, reconciliations, metric search, and variance analysis with source-linked, audit-ready results.

product.name: Deep Dive
product.description: An AI-agent analysis capability that runs many business questions in parallel to uncover drivers, risks, and opportunities across fragmented enterprise data.

product.name: Cadence
product.description: An automated reporting and monitoring service that delivers scheduled business digests, reviews, and variance reports through the application or email.

product.name: Forward Deployed Deployment Services
product.description: Implementation services in which Summation specialists map customer workflows, model key metrics, integrate enterprise data, and configure the platform for rapid adoption.
